title: SVP Discovery Document Schema
description: JSON Schema for the SVP discovery document served at GET /.well-known/svp-identity per RFC 8615. Part of the Sovereignty Verification Protocol (SVP). Version 1.0.0-draft.

svp_supported.description: MUST be true. Signals that this endpoint is SVP-capable.

protocol_version.description: SVP protocol version supported by this AIR.

registry.description: Base URI of the Agent Identity Registry (AIR). HTTPS required.

jwks_uri.description: URI of the JWKS endpoint per RFC 7517. MUST be /.well-known/jwks.json at the registry base URI.

token_endpoint.description: URI of the AIT token issuance endpoint.

revocation_list_endpoint.description: Optional. URI of the Signed Revocation List (SRL) endpoint for edge validator sync.

enrollment_endpoint.description: Optional. URI of the entity enrollment endpoint.

assurance_levels_supported.description: AIT Assurance Levels supported by this AIR.

algorithms_supported.description: JWS signing algorithms supported. HS256 MUST NOT appear.

issuer.description: Issuer identifier. MUST match the iss claim in AIT tokens from this AIR.

srl_ttl_seconds.description: Optional. Default SRL cache TTL in seconds. Default: 300. Maximum: 900.

max_token_ttl_seconds.description: Optional. Maximum AIT token TTL in seconds this AIR will issue.

service_documentation.description: Optional. URI of the AIR service documentation.
